_readme: Card table: what each manager does at the blackjack table ('funny business'). event = what happens (see BlackjackPage.EVENTS). sit = line when they take a seat. lines = said when the event fires. Lines play in dialogue slot 2 (manager box). Cadavire's dealer lines are in dialogue.json (bj_*). raise = Hold'em line when they raise.

sit: Saved you a seat. And a bowl. The bowl is for later.
lines: Oops! My ladle bumped her hole card. You... saw nothing. Wink.
Psst. Look at her card. I tipped it. For you. Only for you.
raise: Raise! Wait. Not against you. I'd never. This is for the soup.
broke: Out of chips. That's fine. I'll go home and make more soup. Soup is my chips.
I lost to you. That's the best way to lose. Bye. Soup later.

sit: I shall play the cards. And then the table. And then the building.
lines: I'll just... take this card. Off the top. Mine now. Everything will be mine.
A burn card! In MY key. Minor. Ominous.
raise: I raise. Crescendo. Fortissimo. Your chips, my chips.
broke: My final movement. A dramatic exit. Do not applaud. Applaud a little.
Silence. The rest is silence. I'm going home.

sit: Counting's just inventory with extra steps.
lines: Shoe's running {hint}, boss. Trust the math.
My gut and my calculator both say {hint}.
raise: Numbers say raise. I listen to numbers.
broke: Inventory: zero. I'm clocking out. Don't follow me.
Hydraulics are out of pressure. Going home to recharge.

sit: Woof. I mean: I am here in a professional capacity.
lines: *hides one of your chips under the table* For safekeeping. Very legal.
Good boy is holding a chip. In his mouth. As a reserve fund.
raise: Raise! *tail wagging* I mean. Raise, professionally.
broke: *sad tail* I'm out. I'm going home. Good game. Good... you.
No more chips. I'll go home and lie on the floor professionally.

sit: Just observing. Not an auditor. Do not check my badge.
lines: This hand is now under... casual review. If you bust, the house was irregular.
I'm flagging this hand. For no reason. Play on.
raise: Raising. For research. On how you react.
broke: My research is done. The results: you are very good. Going home.
Observation concluded. Subject took all my chips.

sit: Bubbles Moretti, at your service. My hands are clean. I wash cars.
lines: I'll help her deal. From the bottom. It's where the good cards sleep.
Sleight of hand? Nah. Sleight of soap.
broke: Bubbles is cleaned out. Bubbles respects that. Bubbles goes home.
You washed me. Nobody washes Bubbles.

sit: We are LIVE. Say hi to the chat. Win something, it's good content.
lines: I'm filming this hand. If you win, the chat sends a tip. 1 Marrow. Very generous chat.
Chat says 'W'. Make it a W.
raise: Raise for the content. Chat, watch this.
broke: Ending the stream. Chat, we got cooked. Go follow them instead.
I'm out. Clip it. That was content.

sit: I don't gamble. I just like the lamp over this table.
lines: Have you tried the felt? Smells like 1998. Wonderful.
I'm not playing. I'm vibing. Deal me out of the deal.
raise: Oh, I'll raise. I like the sound chips make.
broke: Out of chips. I'll go home and look at a different lamp.
I wasn't gambling. I was donating. To you.

sit: I've run the numbers on this table. And on you. Mostly the table.
lines: Projected next card: {hint}. Past results do not guarantee... anything.
The ledger says {hint}. The ledger is never wrong. I died once, though.
raise: A calculated raise. Everything I do is calculated. Even dying.
broke: The numbers say I go home. I always listen to the numbers.
Liquidity: none. I'll see you in thirty minutes. Exactly thirty.

sit: Just sitting. Containing myself. For now.
lines: Nice pot. Shame if some of it... leaked. Into my pocket.
I'm taking a small containment fee from your winnings. Standard.
raise: Raise. Pressure's building. Mine's fine. Yours?
broke: Containment breach. My stack, I mean. Going home to cool off.
Pressure released. All of it. To you.
